observations: Photo 0: Xbox Series X console with a black controller in front, screen showing Xbox dashboard with game icons including FC26, FIFA 24, and others. The console has stickers on top, including 'START ARM' and 'TENTO'.
Photo 1: Same setup, screen shows FIFA 24 gameplay. The console and controller are identical to photo 0.
Photo 2: Screen shows EA FC26 logo. The console has a glowing blue light on the front right. Stickers on the console include 'TENTO' and 'TENTO 2024'.

All photos show the same console and controller, suggesting a single unit. The console appears to be a black Xbox Series X, identifiable by its size, shape, and the glowing blue light on the front right.

The seller claims 6 games are installed, including FC26, FIFA 24, Far Cry 3, Modern Warfare 3, Dishonored 2, and Tomb Raider. FC26 is visible in all photos, FIFA 24 is visible in photo 1, and Tomb Raider is not visible in any photo.
The console is not shown with the disc drive or any other accessories. No power cable or HDMI cable is visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: Only FC26 is visible in all photos. FIFA 24 is visible in photo 1, but Far Cry 3, Modern Warfare 3, Dishonored 2, and Tomb Raider are not visible. The claim of 6 games cannot be confirmed from the photos.

claims.claim: Fc 26, far cry 3, modern warfare 3, dishonored 2 and tomb...
claims.evidence: FC26 is visible in all photos. FIFA 24 is visible in photo 1. Far Cry 3, Modern Warfare 3, Dishonored 2, and Tomb Raider are not visible in any photo. The claim of 5 additional games cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: The console may not be a genuine Xbox Series X or may be a counterfeit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a photo showing the console's power-on boot screen with the model name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic console, not a genuine Xbox Series X.

risks.risk: The games may not be installed or may be pirated copies.
risks.proof: A photo of the game library screen showing all installed games, or a screenshot of the game disc or digital download.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if no games are installed, or as if games are pirated.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have hardware issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have dead buttons.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the controller is non-functional.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the console's model label or serial number.
A video showing the console powering on and booting up.
A photo or video of the game library screen showing all installed games.
A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
